about: How the scan's PDF pages map to the printed pages, for both volumes. Written 2026-11-20 when volume 2 was connected. Printed page (as used in archive refs P<page>L<line> and archive file names) = absolute PDF page - 22 throughout. Volume 1 is printed pp. 1-910 (PDF 23-932; its last text page, p. 910, is the colophon). Volume 2 continues the numbering: its printed page n is archived as page 910+n, at absolute PDF page 932+n. So a volume-2 page whose header reads n is archived as P(910+n).

volumes.scan: archive.org aliflailaorbook02unkngoog (Google scan of the University of Virginia copy, 600 ppi bilevel), re-ordered into reading order: Google scanned the book back to front, with three spreads scanned twice. Each page is set at its true size, so a 300 dpi render matches volume 1.
